summary: Full frontend test of PHP AvrupaPazari site. Post-ad modal bug fix VERIFIED: header '+ İlan Ver' opens #ivOverlay, category->country->plate lookup via RDW works (HLZ85B -> VOLKSWAGEN CADDY 2021), Continue routes to auth modal when logged out and to /pages/post-vehicle.php when logged in with brand prefilled. Auth (login/register/duplicate/wrong-password/logout), theme toggle+persist, language switch (DE -> 'Mitglied werden'), all pages 200 (nope=404), legacy redirects 301, /account.php->302 /?auth=login auto-opens login modal. Sidebars have country_id first on all four category pages, no PHP warnings. Admin login OK, admin pages 200, no forbidden sidebar links.

integration_issues.issue: JS console error on /pages/post-vehicle.php after prefill: 'TypeError: cities.forEach is not a function' at post-vehicle.php:986 (cities response not an array). Also a 404 resource load on same page. Does not block core flow (brand prefill still works).

action_items: Fix cities.forEach TypeError at /app/site/pages/post-vehicle.php ~line 986 - defensively coerce cities to array (Array.isArray(cities) ? cities : (cities?.data || cities?.cities || [])) and confirm the cities endpoint response shape.
Investigate the 404 resource on /pages/post-vehicle.php (check Network tab for missing asset).
critical_code_review_comments: post-vehicle.php cities fetch does not defensively validate the response shape before calling forEach; if the endpoint returns {} or an error object, the page throws in the console.
auth-modal error message text should be i18n-localized (currently Turkish only) if DE/EN/NL translations are required for consistency.
seed_data_creation: Registered one throwaway user test_<random>@avrupapazari.com during duplicate-registration test; not cleaned up (DB is local dev).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All acceptance criteria from the review pass. Only real finding is a cosmetic JS console error on post-vehicle.php (cities.forEach) - fix and re-verify by opening the post-ad modal, logging in as test user, plate=HLZ85B, Continue, and checking DevTools console.
rca of the issue: cities.forEach TypeError: post-vehicle.php:986 assumes cities is an array; when the cities API returns a non-array (e.g. {} on error or wrapped object), forEach fails. Repro: log in as test user, open '+ İlan Ver', choose Araçlar, country NL, plate HLZ85B, click Continue -> navigates to /pages/post-vehicle.php -> open DevTools console. Mitigation: coerce to array before forEach and log the raw payload once for shape confirmation.
